features.name: main.py — launcher
features.detail: argparse CLI: default runs API (uvicorn, daemon thread) + UI (Gradio, main thread); --api-only / --ui-only. Reconfigures stdout to UTF-8, sets up file+stream logging to data/logs/m2v.log. API on 127.0.0.1:8501, UI on 127.0.0.1:7841 (purple/zinc theme). Confirmed launching cleanly in m2v.log (2026-06-09/10).

features.name: QI_M2V NSSM service
features.detail: Installs Windows service QI_M2V via C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe, AppDirectory C:\M2V, runs .venv python main.py, logs to C:\M2V\logs\service.log, SERVICE_DEMAND_START, rotate 1MB. Built and QI_-prefixed but not yet recorded in C:\QIH\ecosystem\QI_Service_Registry.md.

features.name: QI_M2VTunnel (named tunnel)
features.detail: Cloudflare tunnel exposing :7841. File carries a deprecation notice: quick tunnels retired in favour of the static named tunnel qi-m2v (m2v.quiddityinnovations.com), managed centrally at C:\QIH\engine\tunnels\.

features.name: Start_M2V.bat / setup_venv.py
features.detail: Start_M2V.bat runs main.py from .venv (falls back to global Python). setup_venv.py provisions the venv and installs cu128 torch FIRST, then requirements.txt (per the RTX 5080 note).

features.name: QI contract endpoints
features.detail: GET /health -> {status:ok, project:m2v}; /version -> version 0.1.0, status development; /info -> id/name/ports/endpoints/styles/backends. CORS allow_origins=['*'] (permissive — to be tightened). Covered by tests/test_smoke.py.

features.name: POST /api/generate
features.detail: Multipart: audio (UploadFile), lyrics (Form), style, show_lyrics, optional reference_image, ip_scale. Saves uploads to data/uploads/<job_id>, registers an in-memory JOBS entry, spawns a daemon thread running run_pipeline(), returns job_id immediately. No persistence — JOBS is a process-lifetime dict.

features.name: Job polling endpoints
features.detail: GET /api/status/{id} (summary + last_event), /api/status/{id}/events?since=N (incremental event stream the UI consumes), /api/jobs (all jobs newest-first). Drives the live progress log.

features.name: GET /api/download/{id}
features.detail: Returns the finished MP4 as a FileResponse once job status==done; 400 if not ready, 404 if the output file is missing. Verified output files exist in data/output (3 .mp4 + .srt pairs).

features.name: POST /api/extract-lyrics
features.detail: Saves a temp upload, tries _from_id3() first, then Whisper via extract(); returns {lyrics, source(id3|whisper), metadata}. Cleans up the temp file in a finally block.

features.name: run() — staged generator
features.detail: Generator that yields progress dicts per stage: start -> analyzing -> analyzed -> audio -> generating (per clip) -> clip_done/clip_error -> assembling -> done. Creates data/scenes/<job_id> + data/output/<job_id>.mp4. Skips assembly with an error event if every clip fails. Streamed straight to the API JOBS event list.

features.name: Lyric analyzer (LLM director)
features.detail: Splits lyrics on [Verse]/[Chorus] markers, then blank lines, then 4-line chunks; merges down to MAX_SCENES=10. Calls Ollama qwen3:8b (think:false) for a per-segment {prompt, mood, color_palette}; regex-extracts the JSON array; falls back to _fallback_prompt() if Ollama is down. Scene is a dataclass (index/label/lyrics/start/end/prompt/negative/mood/palette).

features.name: Audio analyzer
features.detail: Duration via librosa, then mutagen, then ffprobe, else 180s. Section boundaries via librosa MFCC + agglomerative segmentation (merges shortest gaps to hit n_segments); falls back to even time split on any failure.

features.name: Lyrics extractor
features.detail: ID3 USLT/SYLT (mp3), FLAC lyrics, MP4 \xa9lyr; else Whisper (default 'base', cuda if available) grouped into verse blocks on >2s gaps. get_song_metadata() pulls title/artist/album. Raises LyricsNotFound if both strategies are empty.

features.name: VideoGenerator — SDXL + IP-Adapter
features.detail: StableDiffusionXLPipeline (stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0), fp16 on cuda, attention slicing, 30 steps, guidance 7.5, 1024x576. If a reference image is supplied it load_ip_adapter(h94/IP-Adapter, ip-adapter_sdxl.bin) and set_ip_adapter_scale(ip_scale). Code complete; depends on multi-GB model weights present locally.

features.name: VideoGenerator — Stable Video Diffusion
features.detail: StableVideoDiffusionPipeline (svd-img2vid-xt), fp16, model CPU offload, 25 frames @ 8fps (~3.1s), motion_bucket 127, seed 42, export_to_video; then FFmpeg stream_loop to fill scene duration + scale to 1280x720. VRAM strategy: SDXL (~8GB) and SVD (~8GB) loaded/unloaded alternately to stay within 16GB.

features.name: config/m2v.json backend defs (drift)
features.detail: Config still names backends img_ffmpeg (sdxl-turbo, 4 steps) and cogvideox (THUDM/CogVideoX-5b). These do NOT match the live engine/video_generator.py (SDXL Base 1.0 + SVD). Config is stale relative to code — reconcile or remove.

features.name: assemble() — stitch + mux + subtitle
features.detail: 3 FFmpeg passes: _concat_clips() (concat demuxer, libx264, yuv420p), _replace_audio() (map video + original audio, aac 192k, -shortest), _burn_subtitles() (subtitles filter with force_style). Cleans up intermediates. Produced real .mp4 + .srt pairs in data/output.

features.name: _write_srt() — lyric subtitles
features.detail: Writes an SRT from scene start/end times (first 2 lyric lines per block). Confirmed by data/output/*.srt sample with timed Portuguese captions.

features.name: make_forro_video.py — MoviePy MV builder
features.detail: Self-contained MoviePy renderer: reads scenes.json, Ken Burns zoom per still, 0.8s crossfades, lower-third captions, missing image -> labelled placeholder, fade in/out. Rendered forro_anime_mv.mp4 (1920x1080, 30fps, 160.5s) in 706s (forro_video_build.log) — used placeholders as no real frames were generated.

features.name: generate_frames.py — ComfyUI driver
features.detail: stdlib-only urllib client that drives a running ComfyUI (:8188): auto-detects an anime/SDXL checkpoint, builds a canonical txt2img graph (CheckpointLoader/CLIPTextEncode/EmptyLatent/KSampler/VAEDecode/SaveImage), polls /history, saves scene_##.png. Not yet run — the forro video still uses placeholders per the build log.

features.name: scenes.json — 10-scene storyboard
features.detail: Hand-authored storyboard for 'Churrasco na Geórgia': resolution/fps, style_prefix, negative_prompt, and 10 scenes with start time, label, image, Portuguese caption, and an SDXL positive prompt each.

features.name: Config loader
features.detail: Caches config/m2v.json, loads secrets/m2v.env via python-dotenv if present, dotted-path get(). secrets/m2v.env.template is an empty placeholder (no keys needed — everything runs local).

features.name: Model cache cleanup
features.detail: Removes the abandoned sdxl-turbo from the HuggingFace hub cache; keeps SDXL Base 1.0, IP-Adapter, and SVD. Reports freed GB. Confirms the move off the config-named turbo backend toward the engine's SDXL+SVD chain.

features.name: Live smoke tests
features.detail: pytest hitting :8501 — /health, /version, /info, and /openapi.json. Skips the whole module cleanly if the service is offline so CI stays green.
